_doc: MLP actor-critic brain — 263 → 512 → 256 → (fwd, turn, eat) + value head
name: NN-256
_comment_critic_coef: Weight of critic loss vs actor loss. 0.5 = standard A2C.
_comment_entropy_coef: Entropy bonus. Prevents premature collapse to a single action. Higher than default because signal is sparse.
_comment_weight_decay: Zero — tiny Δvalence gradients cannot compete with L2 decay.
_comment_reward_scale: Scales Δvalence into a useful gradient range. Raw Δvalence is ~0.002/step.
_comment_explore: Gaussian std on fwd/turn. High initial std forces the agent to move and discover food.
_comment_decay: 200k steps = ~55 min at 60fps. Enough time to observe eating/danger events.
